proposed_facts.reason: Confirmed vector and selector consumers and generator application-SRT translation/scale.
Elevated vectors position map-0 joints; only entry zero feeds the generator call.
Source constants and consumers support these roles without establishing compiled adjacency.
Initialization publishes optional caches; on_load destroys their objects without clearing the local pointers.
Dispatcher supplies five arguments; callback uses the item for material forwarding, hiding, effect, sound and small quake, not GObj destruction.
Selection precedes cooldown aging; both recycler directions consume the selected ID.
Joint 38 registration and guarded animation distinguish contact activation from material damage; visual identity appropriately deferred.
Ground helper disables collision. Numeric-76 creation branch and field-ID/index ambiguity are preserved.
Canonical StageData field order places this function in on_load, contradicting rendered OnStart.
Void callback signature and on_load descriptor slot agree.
Load hook performs optional-object destruction, collision refresh and generator setup without clearing caches.
Numeric-stage branch and random guard are exact; broader NULL-generator and roster consequences remain deferred.
Movement adds Y for IDs other than -1 and has no return; recycler ignores the apparent float result.
Retains the declared float signature without inventing a meaningful return contract.
Recycler reads upper-root translation, replaces either endpoint and publishes anchors; callers ignore its bool.
Both crossing branches, initial sentinel guard and absent replacement are represented correctly.
Unconditional asserting spacing lookup precedes the setup sentinel guards.
Setup positioning, upper-active flags and conditional anchor publication match canonical ordering.
Whitebea motion-7 entry calls the stage helper, which reloads scrolling burst state rather than commanding an actor jump.
Getter returns negative stored cur; independent burst substitution and controller boost can change applied displacement.
Terrain callbacks forward their own Ground pointer, while common handling independently looks up controller 10.
Gate return, boost, terminal braking and event branches match; unassigned terminal var_r30 and non-pulse helper result are preserved.
Deferred callback clears the process gate and fills only empty callback slots.
Wrapper publishes cached joints before map-ID-guarded collision maintenance.
Ground setter stores supplied joint references, supporting publication rather than cleanup terminology.
Refresh flag is consumed once; null joint entries leave existing slots unchanged and collision work has a separate guard.
Background subtracts 0.3 times stored scroll and applies one span correction.
Strict comparisons and lack of a loop preclude arbitrary-input normalization guarantees.
Controller-9 call sequence matches; no returned-position dependency exists in the recycler.
Initial selection relies solely on zero markers, making distinctness dependent on nonzero tuning.
Burst multiplier is the deterministic ground-scale accessor; emitted override does not overwrite cur.
Terminal controller-10 path bypasses shared updating, so pending burst consumption is not guaranteed every frame.

contradictions.reason: Accept all seven compiled-section deferrals: initialized allocation/order, a contiguous 70-byte aggregate, a 16-byte pointer section, three .sdata allocation/content claims and pooled two-s16 records cannot be established from C declarations. No compiled evidence was supplied.
Accept corrections to the three constant-role claims: explicit consumers disprove unused-offset/selector and all-particle interpretations.
Accept contact-animation versus damage-response reconciliation and canonical small-quake explanation. Exact visual terrain identity remains deferred.

Accept initialization, lifecycle-name/type/purpose, cache-lifetime and variant-mapping corrections. Collision disabling is not creation; descriptor slot is on_load; destroyed caches are not cleared. Generator NULL consequences, roster and asset-index validity remain explicitly deferred.

Accept selector, movement and recycler corrections: selection serves either endpoint; movement has no explicit return, recycler ignores y and callers ignore its bool. Anchor operations publish references rather than clean them up.
Accept both setup-contract corrections: spacing asserts valid field IDs before either -1 guard, so the representation's sentinel does not establish sentinel-safe initialization.
Accept all three terrain-6 publication corrections. The wrapper invokes publication before collision maintenance; non-null references overwrite slots while skipped nulls preserve prior references.
Accept both background corrections: one strict-boundary correction is not general modulo normalization. Positive scale and bounded displacement are accepted tuning deferrals.
Accept initial-pair distinctness correction: marker tuning, not an explicit ID comparison, prevents reselection. Actual nonzero tuning remains unverified.

Accept controller-10 gate, common callback type and process-state corrections. Terrain forwarding disproves controller-only user_data; early return bypasses flag clearing, and terminal var_r30 remains locally unassigned rather than silently repaired.

Accept Whitebea naming, base-motion getter and both burst corrections. Actor motion-7 entry notifies the stage; scale is not randomness; burst and boost can differ from stored cur, and terminal motion bypasses burst consumption. The document's motion-7 wording appropriately avoids requiring a stronger visual-action identification.
